title: Associate Director, AMI Curricula
description:

Our aesthetics portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, skin care, and more. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. For more information, visit https://global.allerganaesthetics.com/ . Follow Allergan Aesthetics on LinkedIn.
The Associate Director of AMI Curricula is responsible for the development of curricula across Allergan Medical Institute educational programs, primarily new large group programs in-field and in the Training Centers. Main responsibilities include collaboration with key stakeholders (AMI Programs team, Customer Marketing teams, Training Centers team, Design & Internal review team, etc) to develop content to achieve our educational objectives across the HCP learning journey.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following (other duties may be assigned.):
Lead the development of AMI curricula across all large group programming in the AMI Training Centers and in-field programming
Strategic oversight of AMI content and tactics as it relates to large group programs, including: Net new program creation based on Learning Journey, business needs, market demand
Go to market strategy for new programs through Field and digital channels
Strategy for Faculty speaker training and selection, ongoing Faculty training post-launch
Oversight of development of all training materials, videos, slide decks, etc, aligning to brand strategy, KOL review, and adult learning principles
Curricula Lead for all internal Sales communications, including: Liaison between Curricula and Faculty Development team
Coordination of any new initiatives with Commercial Directors
Development of Field Resources (sales aids, targeting tools, etc)
Management of agency partners and content designers to ensure content adheres to creative and curricula briefs, brand guidelines, and MLRC review guidelines
Management of ‘Large Group/Training Center AMI pillar’ team members
Oversight of all workshop and agenda development
Responsible for capturing KOL advisor feedback across all programs
Translating key strategic initiatives into plans and go-to-market tactics for new AMI engagement programs
Coordinating cross-functional internal resources and third parties/vendors for the execution of AMI Engagement initiatives
Building and maintaining strong relationships with KOLs, thought leaders, and other key stakeholders
Coordinating with, and training HCP partners to ensure the execution of successful training programs
Perform other duties as assigned
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent is required.
Minimum of 10 years related experience is preferred.
Experience in curricula development
Experience on product/indication launches
Experience managing a team
Proficient with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and professionally.
Knowledge of FDA and regulatory statutes as applied to Allergan Aesthetics products, with the ability to function in an environment controlled by outside regulatory entities.
Knowledge of procedure training, consultation, business-to business (B2B) and selling skills are desired.
High degree of flexibility in adapting to a rapidly changing environment.
Occasional flexibility in work hours, including weekends, may be required.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Additional Requirements:
Ability to travel up to 40%. Evenings, overnight, weekends, domestic is required.
Language and Verbal Skills:
Individual must have excellent verbal and written communication skills and a demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and professionally.
Analytical and Reading Skills:
Ability to read, understand and abide by company procedures. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions and report on findings.

title: Associate Director, Chief of Staff – People Experience
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Position Summary
The Associate Director, Chief of Staff – People Experience (PE) serves as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to the PE Leadership Team, driving the execution and acceleration of the People Experience vision. This role is a core member of the PE leadership team, responsible for optimizing the PE organization itself — how it operates, prioritizes, plans, and delivers against its agenda. The Chief of Staff acts as an integrator, communicator, and accelerator, translating PE's vision into tangible outcomes and ensuring the PE team functions at its highest potential.
Note: This role is focused on PE organizational optimization — not broad HR optimization, which is a shared accountability across the entire PE team. The Chief of Staff ensures PE as an organization runs with excellence, coherence, and strategic clarity.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Vision Acceleration
Partner with the Head of People Experience and PE leadership to define, refine, and cascade the PE vision and multi-year strategy.
Identify and resolve strategic gaps, dependencies, and opportunities that affect execution of the PE agenda.
Serve as a thought partner to senior PE leaders, bringing an enterprise perspective and anticipating organizational needs before they arise.
Synthesize complex information and distill it into clear, compelling narratives for leadership and stakeholders.
PE Organizational Optimization
Own the continuous improvement of how the PE organization operates — including how the team is structured to deliver, how decisions get made, and how work gets done.
Drive clarity on roles, accountabilities, and interdependencies across PE sub-functions to eliminate duplication and increase team effectiveness.
Identify operational inefficiencies within PE and implement scalable solutions to improve team performance and output quality.
Partner with PE leaders to assess and evolve the operating model as the team's scope and strategy evolve.
Note: Broad HR optimization (e.g., improving HR programs and services for the enterprise) is a shared responsibility across the entire PE team. This role is specifically accountable for optimizing the PE organization itself.
Prioritization & Portfolio Management
Lead and manage the PE Leadership Team's portfolio of strategic initiatives, ensuring alignment to top priorities and business outcomes.
Drive rigorous prioritization frameworks to focus PE resources on the highest-value work.
Track progress against strategic goals and OKRs; escalate risks and recommend course corrections as needed.
Partner with Finance and HR Operations on PE resource planning and investment decisions.
Rhythms of Business & Operating Model
Design, own, and continuously improve the rhythms of business for the PE organization, including leadership team meetings, planning cycles, business reviews, and all-hands communications.
Prepare and curate agendas, pre-reads, and follow-up actions for PE Leadership Team meetings to ensure productive, outcome-oriented sessions.
Coordinate and manage annual and quarterly planning processes, connecting PE plans to broader AbbVie enterprise cycles.
Build and maintain a PE operating calendar that ensures key milestones, deliverables, and decisions are managed proactively.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
Serve as a connector across PE sub-functions, breaking down silos and ensuring integrated execution of the PE strategy.
Represent the PE Leadership Team in cross-functional forums, working groups, and enterprise planning processes.
Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across HR, Business HR, Finance, Communications, and other enabling functions.
Communications & Change Enablement
Develop compelling internal communications for the PE organization, including leadership messages, town halls, strategy updates, and culture-building content.
Champion change management best practices to support adoption of new PE programs, processes, and ways of working within the PE team.
Elevate the PE team's visibility and brand across the enterprise through strategic storytelling and engagement.
Team Effectiveness & Culture
Foster a high-performing, inclusive team culture within the PE Leadership Team and broader PE organization.
Lead special projects and initiatives that strengthen PE organizational effectiveness, engagement, and capability building.
Act as a culture carrier for the PE vision — modeling AbbVie's values and the behaviors the PE team aspires to enable.
Required
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field.
7+ years of progressive experience in HR, strategy, operations, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience operating at a senior level and influencing without direct authority.
Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
Strong executive communication skills — both written and verbal — with the ability to synthesize complexity for senior audiences.
High learning agility, intellectual curiosity, and comfort navigating ambiguity.
Preferred
MBA or advanced degree.
Prior Chief of Staff, HR Strategy, or HR Business Partner experience at a large, matrixed organization.
Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences industry.
Familiarity with organizational design, change management, and workforce planning methodologies.
Competencies
Strategic Thinking & Business Acumen
Influence & Stakeholder Management
Executive Presence & Communication
Execution Discipline & Prioritization
Collaboration & Integration
Learning Agility & Innovation Mindset
Inclusive Leadership
Why People Experience at AbbVie
The People Experience team is at the heart of how AbbVie attracts, develops, and retains the world-class talent needed to deliver on its mission. As a member of the PE Leadership Team, the Associate Director, Chief of Staff will have a front-row seat to enterprise-wide transformation — with a unique opportunity to shape how the PE organization operates and delivers its vision for AbbVie's people now and into the future.

title: Director, EEDI Business Lead- Commercial
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Purpose
This role leads the design and execution of Equity, Equality, Diversity & Inclusion (EEDI) strategies for one of AbbVie's key functions. Reporting to the Director, Programs and Business Partnerships, this individual serves as a strategic driver and takes a hands-on approach — shaping the vision and rolling up their sleeves to make it real. The role partners closely with VP-level leaders, functional EEDI councils, Business HR (BHR), and HR Centers of Excellence (COEs) to deliver measurable business and talent outcomes.
The ideal candidate brings a demonstrated track record of driving organizational impact at scale — someone who combines forward-thinking strategy with a bias for action, and who is equally comfortable setting direction and doing the work. This person operates with both a grounding in proven approaches and a commitment to evolving practices that serve our global, diverse organization.
Responsibilities
Own EEDI functional strategy: Partner with the business to develop the EEDI strategy for assigned function. Lead strategy execution, including roadmap implementation, stakeholder management, communication plans, and achievement of clear measures of success.
Lead and align EEDI councils: Direct the work of EEDI councils by establishing clear goals, aligned priorities, and effective operating models that connect directly to business and EEDI strategy. Facilitate council effectiveness with hands-on engagement through active leadership.
Co-design and manage EEDI programs: Co-design, deliver, and manage EEDI programs that are intentionally inclusive and accessible to all employees. Take ownership of program outcomes, with accountability for adoption and measurable outcomes.
Drive cross-functional alignment: Partner with EEDI leads, BHR and COEs to integrate EEDI principles into foundational people processes and to collaboratively advance new strategies and initiatives — ensuring consistency and coherence across the enterprise.
Embed systemic change in talent processes: Apply change management methodologies to deliver year-over-year progress on key EEDI metrics and overall talent metrics. Ensure aligned and systemic changes across functions, sustained efforts over one-time initiatives.
Serve as a strategic advisor: Advise BHR and COEs on practical, evidence-based ways to embed EEDI into all people and business processes. Provide thought leadership that shapes the HR practices and promotes equitable decision-making — with both global perspective and local sensitivity.
Research and benchmark: Stay up to date on ongoing research and external benchmarking to inform best practices and to identify new opportunities for building a globally inclusive workforce.
Translate data into action: Use AI, workforce data and analytics to identify talent opportunities, assess initiative effectiveness, and establish KPIs that demonstrate measurable business impact. Be a practitioner who understands data and interprets what it means.
Uphold governance standards: Ensure consistent adherence to governance processes and guidelines across all EEDI programming and initiatives.
Education and Experience
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Advanced degree or EEDI Certification preferred.
Minimum 8+ years of related EEDI work experience; 5+ years of leadership or high-level consulting roles.
Experience in translating external and internal trends into innovative practices.
Proven track record of facilitating company-level initiatives with multiple stakeholders.
A deep understanding of how to promote EEDI within a large, complex, multi-national organization.
Experience in senior business partnering and advisory roles; ability to build collaborative, business-focused relationships with senior HR and business leaders.
Strong consulting skills, project planning, management and review, with an ability to roll up sleeves to demonstrate initiative and results-orientation, with a focus on service.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, presentation skills, and facilitation skills.
A proactive, resourceful and self-motivated approach to their work.

title: Quantitative Analyst
description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE


ABOUT THE ROLE

Quant Analysts build and improve the models that drive Base’s Trading & Risk platform - the system that spans our distributed fleet of batteries and the households we serve. You’ll own the price models that tell Base where value exists in wholesale markets like ERCOT and PJM, and the hedging strategy that turns that analysis into a plan for managing Base’s risk.

This is a mid-to-senior role that combines quantitative analysis, software engineering, and energy market expertise. Base has a price model for ERCOT that provides the foundation for future improvements. You’ll extend that work to PJM, sharpen how Base captures grid congestion, and use what you build to shape Base’s hedging strategy there.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Improve Base’s price distributions by capturing grid congestion effects, like midday price excursions regularly seen, that our current models miss

 - Build a price model for PJM, so Base can track risk and make hedging decisions there as well as it already does in ERCOT

 - Build a hedging strategy for PJM, using the models you build to decide what that strategy should be




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Energy markets and domain knowledge: you understand wholesale energy market operations like ERCOT, including real-time arbitrage, ancillary services, and capacity, along with unit commitment, economic dispatch, and production cost modeling

 - Coding and SQL: you build models in Python (or another language) and pull your own data with SQL, and you can work through a model independently

 - Statistics and machine learning: You understand the bias-variance tradeoff, train/validation/test evaluation, and loss functions for categorical and continuous targets, and you’re deeply familiar with at least one statistical subfield, like extreme value theory, information theory, or stochastic processes. You’ve deployed models to production with versioning and maintenance, scaled training beyond a single machine, and know Python, pandas, and visualization libraries well.




ABOUT THE TEAM

Base’s Risk & Trading team turns the grid-service capability of our distributed battery fleet into revenue. That means building and defending the models that decide which markets and products Base participates in, from real-time arbitrage to multi-year distribution deals. The team’s calls carry real weight — a mis-modeled coincident peak or an unvetted market opinion shows up directly in Base’s book. You’ll work alongside traders, market operations engineers, and policy leads who bring the same rigor to distribution-scale energy that a trading desk brings to wholesale power.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.

title: Software Engineer, ML Infrastructure (MDX)

description:
About the Team
DoorDash's MDX team sits within Machine Learning Platform and builds the shared foundation that ML engineers across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo rely on to build and run ML-powered products. We work across the full ML lifecycle: feature engineering, training, evaluation, deployment, serving, and monitoring. Our mission is to increase the velocity and reliability of ML-driven business impact across the company. A central pillar of that work is agentic infrastructure. We are building systems that let agents accelerate and operate the ML workflow itself, including auto research, where agents explore and iterate on modeling ideas, and self-healing systems that detect, diagnose, and remediate failures in ML pipelines and production models with minimal human intervention.
About the Role
You will join a small, high-leverage team building the agentic layer of DoorDash's ML infrastructure. You'll design and build the systems that let agents accelerate how ML engineers across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo develop, ship, and operate models. That includes auto research systems that explore and iterate on modeling ideas, and agentic developer support that helps ML engineers move through training, evaluation, deployment, and debugging faster. You'll own well-scoped components end to end, from design through production, working across agent orchestration, tooling and integrations with our ML platform, evaluation of agent behavior, and observability. This role is ideal for an engineer with a strong backend foundation who is excited to apply AI agents to real engineering workflows, learns quickly, and wants to grow into technical leadership in a fast-moving area where model capabilities, tooling, and best practices change month to month.
You're excited about this opportunity because you will…
Build agentic systems that increase the velocity of ML development across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo, helping ML engineers get from idea to production model faster.
Design and implement infrastructure that lets agents propose, run, and evaluate modeling experiments.
Build agentic developer support for the ML lifecycle, such as agents that help engineers set up training jobs, debug failing pipelines, review model deployments, and navigate our platform.
Develop evaluation and observability for agent behavior, so we can measure whether agents are actually helping, catch regressions early, and build the trust needed to give them more autonomy.
Work with production standards in mind, including reliability, safety guardrails, cost controls, monitoring, and clear playbooks, so that agentic workflows can run against real ML systems.
Partner closely with ML engineers, data scientists, and platform teams to understand where their time goes and turn those workflows into durable, reusable platform capabilities.
Grow quickly in a fast-moving area, with the chance to shape how agents are used to build and operate ML systems at a company of this scale.
We're excited about you because…
B.S., M.S., or PhD in Computer Science or equivalent
2+ years of industry experience in software engineering
Hands-on experience building ML infrastructure in production including feature engineering and feature stores, data pipelines for ML, training and experimentation platforms, model evaluation, deployment, serving and inference, or monitoring
Strong backend engineering fundamentals, especially in Python and distributed systems
Experience operating systems in production, including testing, observability, debugging, and reliability
A good understanding of how ML engineers and data scientists work, and a track record of building platforms, tools, or services that make them more productive
Ability to take ambiguous, well-scoped problems from idea to production, and to learn quickly in a fast-moving technical area
Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) across the software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring, and releasing software
Nice To Haves
Experience building LLM-powered applications or AI agents, including tool use, orchestration, or MCP servers, in production or on substantial projects
Experience with agent evaluation, LLM observability, tracing, or building eval harnesses
Experience with ML platforms or MLOps tooling (e.g., Kubeflow, MLflow, Ray, Airflow)
Experience with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP)
Experience building developer tools, internal platforms, or self-serve infrastructure
Experience with guardrails, safety, or cost controls for LLM systems

description:
About the Team: 

We are a small and fast-moving B2B partnerships team that shapes and executes OpenAI’s most important collaborations. We develop strategic and product partnerships across the B2B ecosystem, bringing together OpenAI’s capabilities and partners’ technology, expertise, data, workflows, and customer relationships. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Sales, we turn these opportunities into useful offerings and new ways for businesses to adopt and benefit from OpenAI.

About the Role: 

As a B2B Ecosystem Lead, you will identify, develop, and execute strategic and product partnerships across B2B segments. This is a hands-on individual contributor role spanning opportunity assessment, partnership design, commercial negotiation, and execution. You will own the partner work behind product initiatives, from defining partner needs through launch and sustained adoption at scale. These may include Sign in with ChatGPT and industry-specific offerings. You bring a generalist’s ability to connect product priorities with partner capabilities, build a business case, and align teams around a practical path forward. You will remain accountable after signing and launch, including for selected high-touch strategic partnerships.

Key Responsibilities:

 - Identify strategic and product partnership opportunities across B2B segments; translate product priorities and customer needs into partner plans, joint value propositions, and a focused set of prospective partners.

 - Own the partner work stream for assigned product initiatives, aligning requirements, commitments, milestones, and ongoing responsibilities with Product, Engineering, and partner teams.

 - Develop business cases and negotiate product and commercial partnerships with Legal, Finance, and Product, including selected high-touch strategic deals in coordination with other partnership owners.

 - Take partner initiatives from pilot through launch and scale, defining readiness criteria, coordinating integrations, and expanding successful offerings to more partners and business customers.

 - Work with Sales and partner teams on target accounts, referrals, joint selling, and customer introductions, with clear responsibilities for follow-up and opportunity tracking.

 - Coordinate Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Security, Policy, and Operations to resolve launch and adoption barriers, with clear ownership and handoffs into ongoing partner programs.

 - Maintain partner relationships after launch and bring customer feedback, integration gaps, and adoption barriers back to Product and Engineering; help turn early implementations into repeatable offerings.

 - Define success measures with product and go-to-market teams, track activation, sustained usage, customer outcomes, and commercial impact, and drive follow-up when an initiative falls short.

Qualifications:

 - 8+ years of experience in business development, strategic or product partnerships, or related roles developing commercial opportunities in technology or other B2B businesses.

 - Experience developing B2B partnerships and taking a product, integration, or partner initiative from concept or pilot through launch and sustained adoption, working closely with product and technical teams.

 - A broad business perspective and the ability to learn unfamiliar industries, evaluate partner capabilities and strategic fit, and turn an ambiguous opportunity into a clear business case and partnership plan.

 - Understanding of how businesses use software, data, and services, and how product integrations, distribution, and complementary capabilities create value. Experience across B2B sectors and business models is a plus.

 - Strong commercial and analytical judgment, including the ability to assess economics, prioritize competing opportunities, and use performance data to guide decisions.

 - Ability to build relationships with partner practitioners and leaders, work effectively across technical and business teams, and move projects forward without formal authority.

 - Clear writing and communication, curiosity about AI, and a willingness to do the detailed work of growing partnerships. You combine initiative and adaptability with disciplined follow-through.

title: Client Platform Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI’s Client Platform Engineering team builds and operates the platforms that make employee devices secure, reliable, and easy to use. Our work spans device posture and trust, onboarding, application delivery, operating-system updates, fleet telemetry, and employee-facing remediation. We partner with Security, IT, Research, Applied, and specialized engineering teams to reduce friction while protecting OpenAI’s systems and data.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Client Platform Engineer, You will build and own agentic solutions that automate OAI fleet operations and reduce employee friction, with measurable outcomes and reliability. You will develop first-party software, integrate commercial and open-source tools, and own changes from design and testing through deployment and production operations. Your work will improve security, reliability, and the employee experience.

We’re looking for people who are passionate about automation, endpoint security, and building scalable solutions that improve employee experience. You should have deep experience securing and managing Linux fleets at scale, with strong software engineering skills to automate security controls and fleet operations across environments with different compliance requirements. Your problem-solving mindset and attention to detail will be key to success in this role.

In this role, you will:

Build the platforms that help employees do their best work on devices they can trust.

 - Own the design, development, deployment, and operation of secure Linux endpoint management systems across environments with different compliance requirements.

 - Create magical employee experiences by building agentic workflows with OpenAI products and models that use fleet telemetry to anticipate issues, guide remediation, and design friction out of everyday work.

 - Make new hires productive from day one, using OpenAI products to simplify device setup, software delivery, and onboarding support.

 - Build secure, reliable workflows with scoped access, human review for sensitive changes, traceable actions, and tested recovery.

 - Partner with IT, Security, Research, and Engineering to deliver consistent Linux provisioning, updates, and support alongside macOS and Windows.

 - Develop first-party software and integrate commercial and open-source tools for software packaging, deployment, and application management.

 - Manage fleet configuration as code through GitOps, version control, peer review, and automated validation.

 - Build and operate CI/CD pipelines for fleet infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and GCP, with staged deployments and tested rollback.

 - Use fleet telemetry to proactively improve performance and reliability, detect configuration drift, and verify deployment outcomes.

 - Participate in engineering on-call, own incident resolution, and turn operational lessons into lasting improvements that reduce recurring failures and manual work.


YOU MAY BE A FIT FOR THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE: 

 - Proficiency in Python, Go, or another modern programming language.

 - Deep experience securing and managing Linux fleets with configuration management, MDM, device enrollment, policy enforcement, and cloud identity integration.

 - Demonstrated success with open-source endpoint tools for configuration, device and application management, and telemetry.

 - Experience delivering secure, reliable, scalable systems across different compliance requirements.

 - Deep experience managing infrastructure at scale with IaC and GitOps, using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, and Chef.

 - Experience integrating and operating fleet infrastructure with CI/CD and DevOps workflows.

 - A track record of deploying and operating fleet infrastructure in public cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).

 - Initiative, analytical judgment, and the ability to turn problems into practical improvements.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE:

 - Deep experience with open-source fleet management tools and frameworks.

 - Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

 - Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, and NIST.

 - Strong soft skills, including stakeholder communication and cross-functional collaboration.

 - Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, CCSP.

 - A security thought leader with contributions to CPE open-source projects or technical communities.

title: Enterprise Security Engineer, Vulnerability Management
description:
About the Team

Enterprise Security protects the systems, identities, devices, and services that enable OpenAI's employees to work securely and effectively. We partner across IT and Security to understand risk, build practical defenses, and support a rapidly evolving technical environment.

About the Role

We are looking for an Enterprise Security Engineer with a focus on vulnerability management, novel vulnerabilities, and zero-day response. You will investigate vulnerabilities and security weaknesses across networks, endpoints, and SaaS, prioritize them in the context of real exposure, and drive remediation through verified outcomes.

You will also build security capabilities and automation, use AI agents to solve practical problems, and help shape how enterprise security operates as agents become a larger part of everyday work.

This role is open to candidates in San Francisco, CA, and to remote candidates in the United States.

In this role, you will:

 - Discover, investigate, and prioritize vulnerabilities and misconfigurations across enterprise systems, including novel vulnerabilities and zero-days with incomplete information and no established playbook.

 - Translate technical findings into clear attack paths, business impact, and actionable remediation.

 - Develop and validate emergency mitigations when patches are unavailable, coordinate with system owners, vendors, and incident responders, and drive durable fixes through verified closure.

 - Improve asset visibility, ownership, vulnerability data quality, and reporting.

 - Build and operate security tools and integrations using code, APIs, automation, and AI agents.

 - Design controls for agent access, execution, and accountability.

 - Contribute across endpoint, network, identity, and SaaS security, and support incident investigations when needed.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have independently investigated novel or emerging vulnerabilities and driven enterprise remediation from uncertain initial reports through mitigation and verified closure.

 - Bring technical depth in a relevant security domain and working knowledge across networks, endpoints, and SaaS.

 - Can understand and improve code and safely integrate APIs and security systems.

 - Have solved substantive problems using AI agents and can explain how you evaluated and corrected their work.

 - Think clearly about security tradeoffs, ambiguous evidence, and the changing risks of agentic systems.

 - Collaborate effectively, take ownership, and communicate technical risk to varied audiences.

description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

AI will change how the world works. Human connection will shape what it becomes. OpenAI’s Events and Experiences team, part of Business Marketing, carries the critical responsibility of bringing people together around OpenAI’s mission – building artificial general intelligence that benefits all of humanity. We strive to put human benefit in the spotlight and craft experiences that build trust, spark possibility, and make the future feel within reach and exciting. We are not a traditional events team: we move with extreme speed, rigor, and precision. We use AI tools to rethink everything from the first plan to the final guest moment – and we bring grit, joy, humor, and extraordinary creative talent to create what has not existed before.

We’re looking for an Experiential Producer to put OpenAI’s latest technology in people’s hands. You’ll produce experiences where people discover something they didn’t know they could do with our products, whether they’re trying ChatGPT for the first time or building with our newest developer tools. From intimate demos to global launches, cultural programs, large-scale events, booths, and brand installations, you’ll help shape how people experience OpenAI around the world.

Working closely with Product, Marketing, and creative partners, you’ll take concepts through design development, fabrication, and on-site delivery. You’ll bring deep experience producing booths and custom builds, managing agencies and vendors, and working directly with fabricators to understand what’s possible within the budget and timeline.

This role needs someone who can run several projects at once and stay close to the details. You’re resourceful when plans change, comfortable making decisions on your feet, and clear with the people depending on you. You take pride in producing great work and bring a sense of humor and genuine enthusiasm to the process.



IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Produce the experiences that introduce people to OpenAI’s newest products, from global launches and hands-on demos to custom installations around the world.

 - Work with Product, Marketing, and creative teams on what’s coming next, turning ambitious concepts into production briefs and build plans for different audiences.

 - Bring together agencies, fabricators, technical specialists, and venues to solve builds that don’t have an off-the-shelf answer, from early prototypes to finished experiences.

 - Set success measures and use audience response, product engagement, business results, and partner feedback to improve future experiences, reusable production tools, and vendor standards.

 - Deep experience producing booths and custom builds, with a portfolio showing sound design judgment, practical problem-solving, and careful execution.

 - Experience working with Product, Engineering, or technical teams, and genuine curiosity about how OpenAI’s products work.

 - The initiative to own projects independently: set milestones, make decisions, and tackle unfamiliar problems without waiting to be asked.

 - A diverse network of trusted agencies and vendors, strong negotiation skills, and good judgment about when to use a full-service agency or a specialist.

 - Experience adapting production for different audiences, cultures, event scales, and markets while keeping global standards consistent.

 - A natural collaborator who enjoys meeting people and hearing new ideas. You listen with empathy and build trust across teams and partners.

description:

Job Description:
About bp
Our purpose is to bring together people, energy and markets to power and navigate a changing world. In a time of constant change and possibility we need new talent to pursue commercial opportunities, fueled by world-class insight and expertise. We’re always striving for more innovative digital solutions, sustainable outcomes and closer collaboration across our company and beyond, and you could be part of that too!
About the team
We are seeking a commercially oriented Market Data & Intelligence professional to support the East Sales team with power market expertise, prospect intelligence, data-driven insights, and market-facing content.
This role will bridge Sales, Supply, Pricing/Costing, Analytics, and Marketing , helping the sales organization understand market conditions, identify high-potential prospects, and translate market and customer data into actionable commercial opportunities.
The ideal candidate combines strong knowledge of U.S. power markets with analytical, research, communication, and commercial skills. They should be comfortable supporting customer meetings, researching prospects, developing market insights, and turning complex information into clear recommendations for Sales.
Key Accountabilities
Market Intelligence & Sales Support
Serve as a market subject-matter resource for the East Sales team, with a focus on U.S. power markets and Eastern markets .
Supervise wholesale power markets, capacity, congestion, transmission, renewable requirements, regulatory developments, and other factors impacting retail electricity pricing.
Provide market expertise and analytical support during customer and broker meetings , helping Sales explain market conditions, pricing trends, risks, and opportunities.
Develop concise market updates, talking points, presentations, and other materials that Sales can use with customers and brokers.
Provide customer-specific market analysis and insights to support sales strategies and customer engagement.
Translate sophisticated market information into clear, commercially relevant insights .
Prospect Intelligence & Lead Generation
Research and identify high-potential commercial and industrial prospects within target markets and customer segments.
Use market, customer, industry, and company data to identify and prioritize attractive sales opportunities.
Develop prospect profiles incorporating relevant information such as locations, estimated electricity usage, market exposure, business characteristics, sustainability initiatives, and potential buying indicators .
Identify trigger events that may create opportunities for outreach, including facility expansions, acquisitions, new locations, sustainability initiatives, regulatory changes, and contract or renewal timing.
Develop targeted prospect lists and account intelligence that enable Sales to conduct more focused and relevant outreach .
Partner with Sales to refine target customer profiles and continuously identify new sources of qualified leads.
Data & Commercial Analytics
Analyze internal and external data to identify sales opportunities, market trends, customer segments, and commercial insights .
Develop dashboards, reports, and recurring intelligence to help Sales leadership understand market opportunity, pipeline, customer trends, and competitive positioning.
Partner with Pricing/Costing and Supply to interpret market movements and their implications for retail pricing and competitiveness.
Identify trends and opportunities that warrant further analysis and communicate findings to Sales leadership.
Support strategic projects related to market expansion, customer growth, and commercial strategy.
Marketing & Thought Leadership
Partner with Marketing to develop market-driven campaigns, customer communications, presentations, newsletters, and thought leadership .
Provide market data, trends, charts, and analysis for external marketing and sales materials.
Identify market developments that can support targeted prospect and customer campaigns .
Help develop content that demonstrates the company's expertise and credibility in energy markets.
Support webinars, customer events, sales presentations, and other market-facing initiatives.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Build strong relationships across Sales, Supply, Pricing/Costing, Risk, Marketing, and Analytics .
Act as a connector between market intelligence and commercial execution.
Ensure relevant market and data insights are communicated effectively to Sales and incorporated into commercial strategies.
Support Sales leadership with ad hoc market research, analysis, and strategic projects.
Essential experience and job requirements:
Senior experience in power markets, retail electricity, wholesale energy, energy analytics, pricing, trading, business intelligence, or a related field.
Strong understanding of U.S. electricity markets, ideally including ISO-NE, NYISO, PJM, and/or other Eastern markets .
Strong analytical skills and experience working with market and customer data.
Experience with prospect research, market research, account intelligence, lead generation, or sales analytics preferred.
Advanced Excel skills; experience with Power BI, SQL, Python, CRM, or similar tools is a plus.
Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
Ability to explain complex energy-market concepts to customers, brokers, and non-technical sales professionals .
Strong commercial judgment and ability to connect data and market developments to potential business opportunities.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across functions.
Why join bp:
At bp, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and challenging environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to encouraging an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly.
There are many aspects of our employees’ lives that are meaningful, so we offer benefits to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits can include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, and excellent retirement benefits, among others!
